Chapter 6674: To The Shore

Chapter 6674: To The Shore

“So should we try, Fellow Daoist?” Evil Transformation asked earnestly.

“I would in your position, there is no better option and it might succeed.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Yes, succeed.” Fiendish Ground focused on this possibility.

“I already agreed since I don’t want to miss this interesting experiment. Who else can try besides you two?” Li Qiye said.

“It is decided.” The two spoke in unison.

“As agreed upon but first, show me what you can do. Try not to make me laugh.” Li Qiye said.

Listeners had no idea what they agreed to do. It sounded as if they were close friends with a pact. They expected a fight to break out instantly, not a long conversation.

Those who have never seen immortals before relished the moment. Others speculated on the agreement and its implications for Three Immortals.

Heaven-slayers and primal ancestors were concerned about the implications since they were tied to the Three Immortals. The hidden primordial immortals have finally shown themselves and will not leave before reaching their goal. Thus, many hoped for Li Qiye’s victory.

After all, they saw Bao Pu’s wrath earlier. These two immortals might try the same. Only Li Qiye had no intention of refining Three Immortals.

“We’ve waited for you to be here, Fellow Daoist.” Fiendish Ground said.

“It is an honor, you two seem eager to die.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Indeed, we are ready.” Evil Transformation said.

“I suppose you do need my help, after all, committing suicide is difficult for an immortal.” Li Qiye said.

“I wouldn’t go that far.” Fiendish Ground laughed.

Oddly, his laughter felt sincere. Others connected with him more despite his strange form.

“This is rather convenient for you two.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, but don’t be so sure about the outcome just yet.” Fiendish Ground said.

“Still confident?” Li Qiye asked.

“We aren’t confident in ourselves, we’re confident in him.” Evil Transformation said before pointing at the sky.

“Fair enough.” Li Qiye glanced at the sky and said: “I would also be confident in the villainous heaven, it’s the epitome of the world after all.”

“It’s rather interesting, isn’t it?” Evil Transformation said.

“This means you two aren’t confident in me.” Li Qiye smiled.

“We want to be.” Fiendish Ground said.

“But still more confidence in the villainous heaven.” Li Qiye said.

“Not quite, it’s just hard not to take advantage of this opportunity.” Evil Transformation said.

“If I can’t handle it, then you two will be the big winners, reaching the shore and eliminating me in one go.” Li Qiye said.

“It goes further than that, Fellow Daoist.” Evil Transformation said.

“So are you entertaining us?” Fiendish Ground was more direct.

“This is no longer a matter of choice now that you two are in your astral form.” Li Qiye said.

“Indeed.” The two responded.

“Don’t disappoint me, let’s make this interesting matter even more fun.” Li Qiye said.

“A fight is inevitable, wait until we reach the shore.” Evil Transformation said.

“No intention of hiding, I see.” Li Qiye said.

“This is predicated on your survival.” Fiendish Ground said.

“I will try my best since I don’t want to be looking around for you two any longer, it’s too much of a hassle.” Li Qiye nodded.

“Not a problem.” The two said.

“We agree to fight after reaching the shore.” Evil Transformation said.

“No backing out.” Li Qiye agreed.

“No backing out.” The two promised.

“What is this shore?” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost asked Bao Pu.

Both were far away. Bao Pu stared at the trio and said: “I do not know, but it’s time to finish this.”

They exchanged glances before staring in Weizhen’s direction. Weizhen stood there emotionlessly; no one could read him.

“Are you sure?” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost whispered.

“Yes.” Bao Pu confirmed.

Meanwhile, Evil Transformation asked Li Qiye: “It’s time for us to see your grand dao.”

“Your grand dao has been gone for a while, it’s time for its return.” Li Qiye smiled.
